title: Wyrd Sisters
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: Three Discworld witches protect a baby prince after the murder of his father by a usurping duke and his wife. The plot borrows freely from Macbeth and Hamlet and mocks theatre and royalty.
readIf: you like funny fantasy full of wordplay and Shakespeare jokes.
skipIf: you want a serious fantasy or prefer to begin a series at its first book.
